== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An Enforcer is a type of [[sacred artist]] defined by a [[spirit]] dedicated to protection and guardianship. Their primary role involves using their great strength to defend their clan or organization. This specialization is characterized by the ability to focus [[madra]] into physical attributes, granting them superior speed, toughness, and strength compared to other artists of the same level. [[Enforcers]] utilize various techniques to enhance their capabilities. While many employ full-body [[Enforcement]] to protect and power their entire form, others use specialized techniques focused on single strikes, rapid movement, or weapon reinforcement. These methods can be highly taxing, often straining muscles and joints or causing internal heat and damage that requires the artist to use [[madra]] for healing. Some advanced techniques, such as those used by the [[Blackflame family]], can even manifest as protective or offensive visual effects like a burning cloak. In social and combat hierarchies, [[Enforcers]] are often identified by specific badges, such as those featuring a shield or a hammer. They serve in various capacities, ranging from clan protectors and specialized combatants to members of organized groups like the [[Skysworn]], who act as judges and enforcers of law. Their combat effectiveness is often enhanced by their ability to use [[madra]] to bolster their physical presence, making them formidable opponents in battle.}}
